runs.name: Companhia de Saneamento Básico do Estado de São Paulo - SABESP; NYSE SBS (ADSs, one share each), B3 SBSP3, SEC CIK 0001170858, 20-F filer in Brazilian reais; water and sewage services, 371 municipalities of the state of São Paulo under the Concession Agreement for URAE-1 to 2060; privatized 2024-07-22, the State of São Paulo from 50.26% to 18.00%, Equatorial S.A. 15% as Reference Investor; 1:5 split 2026; merger of the shares of EMAE at 1.3195 SABESP shares per EMAE share, credited 2026-10-27 (6-K 2026-10-21); the 20-F names no rival company, American Water Works, Essential Utilities and California Water Service chosen as a CONVENTION of the run, Copasa and Sanepar flagged as not SEC filers
runs.box: OUT AT Q7, ON PRICE (above the top of the range)
runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the 20-F's Items 4, 3.D and 5; the foreign-filer paragraph (read from the 20-F and 6-Ks; the BRL sovereign from its issuing authority). tools/run.py failed on the IFRS filer (no FY2025 SEC facts); every figure typed from the filed statements. Price **R$25.53** SBSP3 (close 2026-10-27, aggregator, flagged; ADS US$4.75, one share each; both fell about 21% on 2026-10-26 with the Ibovespa down about 14%, no 6-K after 2026-10-21, the cause not used) x **3,517,275,575 shares** (3,534,409,282 common under the bylaws effective on the EMAE merger, 6-Ks of 2026-09-23 and 2026-10-21, less 17,133,707 treasury shares derived from the 20-F Item 16E and the interim note 28(c); cover count cross-check within 0.02%) = cap **R$89,796M**; sovereign **14.93%** (Tesouro Nacional, Tesouro Direto NTN-F 2037-01-01, base date 2026-10-27; 12.90% on 2026-10-23). **Q1 IN** (a water and sewage concession with a written tariff model: inflation-indexed, a pre-tax WACC on the asset base, Factor U and Q adjustments). **Q2 IN** on the legal monopoly by contract to 2060, the filing naming no rival; regulated return carried to Q3; the threat is the regulator and the grantor (Factor U can cut the tariff up to 10% a year, missed targets bar dividends above the 25% minimum, forfeiture possible). **Q3 weighs against** (compulsory R$70bn programme 2024 to 2029). **Q4 weighs against, not a STOP** (non-cash IFRIC 12 financial-asset inflation revenue R$9.15bn 2024 and R$1.68bn 2025, a R$1bn change of estimate December 2025; internal control not effective at the 2024 and 2025 year-ends; the FY2024 20-F/A corrected legal claims printed as R$167.7bn to R$24.7bn). **Q5 integrity IN, ability weighs for lightly** (two years of record). **Q6 against** (late-2025 buyback of 3,452,087 pre-split shares at R$136.26, about R$27.25 after the split, no price limit, partly to cover incentive plans; dividends above the minimum tied to Factor U and leverage). Borrowings R$19.5bn (2023) to R$51.7bn (2026-06-30), net debt R$39.8bn with PPP and swap liabilities. **Q7 OUT, on price, above the top of the range**: owner cash equity-only 2021 to 2025 after maintenance (depreciation as the guess) 960, 910, 1,308, 4,123, 5,672, average **R$2,595M**; after all spending -534, -263, -39, -1,231, -5,860, average -R$1,586M, negative every year; growth 55.9% cut to the business's own sales growth 10.1% under (f); growth spending R$4,180M year one to R$9,941M year ten; utility debt credit R$2,292M at the business's own 54.8% long-term debt share (the filing states no allowed share), binding. Value range equity-only, central, at the sovereign **R$4.94 to R$5.21 a share**; all-equity not positive; post-privatization bases beside (2024 to 2025, TTM, 2025 alone) top out at R$15.99, below the price. Expected return at the price 5.2% growth, 2.9% no-growth; no case earns the floor. **Fair price R$8.67 equity-only, central** (about US$1.61 an ADS at 5.37), all-equity R$-0.56, not positive. Peers (CONVENTION of the run): AWK, WTRG, CWT about 8% to 11% on equity in dollars 2016 to 2025; Sabesp 10% to 16% in reais 2016 to 2023, 21% to 29% in 2024 and 2025 lifted by the non-cash revenue. Could not get: a regulatory WACC or allowed debt share; 2016 to 2019 balance sheets checked against filed pages (SEC data only); EMAE's own filings; a filing confirming the merger's completion; treasury shares as read (derived). Process departures declared by the analyst: Q3 to Q7 committed together (32fc5b61), not one by one; the valuation arithmetic run before Q4 was written, its output file not headed COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE. Framework gaps for the operator: the floor of about ten percent below a 14.93% sovereign, which the text assumes cannot happen; a five-year window straddling a change of regime (the 2024 privatization); whether PPP and swap liabilities count as long-term debt in the utility credit; depreciation as the maintenance guess under IFRIC 12 concession accounting; no BRL sovereign row in the protocol's table. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 69 ids in the ledger, 14 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, one flagged (L2016-002 beside a quotation from the 20-F Item 16E, a checker mispairing, not a slip); no tracked research file over 200 KB. Contamination declared: five CWCO commit subjects and the project map in the session context; none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Armed at the equity-only fair price on SBSP3.SA in BRL.
runs.narr: OUT at Q7 on price: the São Paulo water and sewage concessionaire, privatized 2024, a legal monopoly to 2060 under a regulator's tariff model, with compulsory spending, negative owner cash after all spending every year, non-cash concession revenue and two years of ineffective internal control; equity-only value range R$4.94 to R$5.21 at a 14.93% Brazilian sovereign against R$25.53. Fair R$8.67 equity-only, central; all-equity not positive; armed on SBSP3.SA.
